Privacy enquiry ↗
01

Who this policy covers

This policy explains how ADKEA handles information collected through this website and its enquiry and onboarding forms. ADKEA provides creative and digital marketing services for businesses in India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

For privacy enquiries, email connectadkea@gmail.com or call +91 99558 01777. Registered address: D26, Ground Floor, AFE, Okhla, New Delhi 110025. Other business addresses are listed on our contact page.

02

Information you share

We receive the details you enter or share when contacting us:

  • Project enquiries: name, email, phone, company if provided, selected services, timeline and your project message.
  • Agency enquiries: contact details, location, agency name, website if provided, expertise, markets, team size if provided and partnership brief.
  • Creator applications: contact details, location, public profile links, content category, audience information, languages and collaboration preferences.
  • Brand campaigns: contact and company details, campaign objective, market, audience, timing, preferred formats and any optional budget or campaign information you provide.
  • Direct conversations: the information you choose to share by email, telephone or WhatsApp.

Please keep messages relevant to the enquiry. Do not submit passwords, payment-card information, medical records or other sensitive personal details.

03

How we use information

We use enquiry information to respond, understand the brief, discuss services and prepare potential collaborations. Creator and agency details help us review a possible campaign or partnership fit. If work is agreed, information may also be used to coordinate delivery and maintain the business relationship.

Submitting an enquiry does not automatically join a mailing list. Permission to contact you about your enquiry is separate from any future marketing subscription. Where processing relies on your consent, you can withdraw it by contacting us.

04

Forms, hosting and external services

Our forms use FormSubmit to forward submissions to connectadkea@gmail.com. FormSubmit handles the details entered in the form and may use Google reCAPTCHA or other spam checks during submission. These services can process technical information such as an IP address and browser signals.

Our website hosting provider and email provider also process information needed to deliver pages, receive messages, maintain technical logs and protect their services. ADKEA does not add a third-party analytics script or advertising pixel to this website at the date shown above.

Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp links take you to external services when you choose to open them. Those services handle information under their own policies. We do not embed their feeds or tracking widgets on these pages.

05

Cookies and browser storage

The website’s testimonial Like buttons store your selections in local storage in your browser so a selected state can remain after reloading. This preference is not sent to ADKEA by the website and is not an account or a verified public popularity count.

You can remove it by clearing this site’s browser storage. Website functionality, hosting or submission providers may use their own cookies or security storage. Blocking those technologies can affect external form submission. Fonts and website artwork are hosted with the site.

06

Sharing and access

We use service providers for hosting, form delivery and email rather than treating an enquiry as permission for unrelated advertising. We do not sell enquiry information or make it public on the website.

Relevant details may be shared with people helping respond to your request or deliver agreed work, or where disclosure is required by applicable law. A creator application does not automatically authorise us to publish private contact details as part of a public portfolio.

07

Retention and international processing

We keep enquiry and collaboration information for as long as it is needed to handle the request, support a relevant business relationship and meet applicable record-keeping requirements. The appropriate period depends on the type of record and the purpose. Contact us if you want to ask about information associated with your enquiry.

ADKEA works through teams in India and the UAE, and uses providers that may process information in other countries. Your enquiry may therefore be handled outside the country from which you contact us. Provider practices and applicable requirements govern their processing; this policy does not claim that all records remain in one country.

08

Your choices and privacy requests

You can contact us to ask about your information, request a correction or deletion, or withdraw permission for further enquiry-related contact. Depending on the applicable law, you may have additional rights concerning access, processing, portability or complaints to a relevant authority.

Email connectadkea@gmail.com with your request. We may ask for limited information to verify that we are responding to the right person. Some records may need to be retained to meet legal obligations or resolve a dispute. You can contact us directly by email instead of submitting a web form.

09

Security and appropriate use

The live website uses HTTPS. We ask visitors to provide only the information needed for their enquiry. No online transmission or storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

These enquiry and professional onboarding forms are intended for adults and business contacts. If a child’s information has been submitted, contact us so we can review and address it. A creator application does not create a contract or confirm eligibility for a campaign.

10

Updates and contact

We may update this page as our website or data practices change. The last-updated date shows the current version. If a new tracker, form provider or data use is introduced, the policy should describe that change before it is relied on.

Questions about this policy? Email ADKEA or visit the Contact page.
